Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded. Can you confirm you're comfortable
continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Could you walk me through what happened at the intersection?
A: I was making a left turn at a signal, heading into a shopping center. The light had changed to green, and I waited
for oncoming traffic to clear before I started moving.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not clearly. I saw headlights when I was partway through the turn, but I thought I had enuogh room. The other car
hit the front passenger side of mine.
Q: How fast were you going when you started the turn?
A: Very slowly, probably under ten miles an hour. I was almost stopped at the point where I committed to the turn.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Can you describe your injuries?
A: My right shoulder is hurting quite a bit. I felt a sharp pain right when the airbag went off, and it has gotetn worse
since. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week, and I can't lift my arm above shoulder height without pain.
Q: Have you seen a doctor about the shoulder?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same evening and then saw my primary care doctor later in the week. They ordered
an MRI.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Only that I've been careful and I believe I followed the signal correctly. I'm hoping this can be resolved so I can get
back to normal.
Q: Thank you. That concludes our recorded statement.
</page>
